summary: First E2E test iteration for منصة مفكري المستقبل. Wrote and executed 31 pytest cases covering auth, geo hierarchy, books (list/detail/favorite/progress/review/recommendations), gamification (checkin, /me level_progress), clubs, dialogue forum, chess quick-match + turn validation, events (create/register/participants), competitions (create/register/submit/leaderboard), leaderboards (national all/weekly/monthly + schools/directorates/governorates), book upload+approve moderation flow, notifications, global search, admin overview/analytics/users/points-config/audit-logs/broadcast/role-change, and RBAC. All 31 backend tests PASSED (15.28s). Frontend playwright smoke: landing dynamic stats OK, admin login → admin dashboard with 7 tabs and charts, registration flow (governorate→directorate→school cascade) via UI → student dashboard, library grid with 13 book cards, book detail + reader iframe modal, leaderboard 4 scope tabs, clubs page, chess arena with quick-match-btn all work.

ui_bugs.issue: The daily check-in button on the student dashboard renders as 'حضور اليوم' but does not carry data-testid='checkin-btn'. Backend endpoint works. Consider adding testid for consistency with review_request.

issues: Two 404s in browser console for a missing asset (likely favicon/cover placeholder); non-blocking but should be traced and fixed

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='checkin-btn' to the daily-checkin CTA on Dashboard for parity with request spec.
Optional: investigate console 404s for missing static asset.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: login lockout uses IP+email identifier and *updates locked_until on every failed attempt*, effectively extending lockout indefinitely — consider setting locked_until only when count crosses MAX_ATTEMPTS. Currently mitigated by expiry check but semantics are slightly off.
books_routes.py get_book increments views on every GET including unauthenticated repeats — could inflate metrics; consider throttling per session/user.

chess_routes.py make_move accepts FEN/SAN directly from client with no server-side legality check (client-side chess.js only). A malicious client can push arbitrary FEN. This is documented as an accepted design in the request note, but flagging as a security/data-integrity concern.
admin_routes.py PUT /admin/users/{uid}/role does not prevent self-demotion of the sole super_admin — potential lockout risk.

leaderboard_routes.py student_leaderboard for period='weekly/monthly' loads all students into memory then sorts in Python — will not scale beyond a few thousand users. Should aggregate in Mongo pipeline.

server.py CORS_ORIGINS default is '*' but allow_credentials=True; browsers reject '*' with credentials. Works in this env because CORS_ORIGINS is unset but the wildcard fallback is misleading — remove fallback.
